_help: Towns of Palestine are shown under their names from before the occupation (the owner, 17/10); the names matched stay every spelling the news uses. The map's gazetteer (src/radar/osint.py): [Danish name shown, kind, lat, lon, [names matched in headlines, lower case, English, Danish and common spellings]]. kind: s = city, town, camp or site (exact), r = region, strait or sea, c = country (its centre: shown as approximate). The most specific place in a headline wins. Never add an adjective ('Israeli', 'russisk') or a word that is also a common word or a person's name.
